item.title: Technical Resources
item.description:
Welcome to the Technical Resources section of Kimi Embroidery Repair Tech Station.

This section provides practical technical information to help embroidery machine users diagnose problems, improve machine performance, and maintain their equipment.

What You’ll Find Here

Our technical resources include:

  • Troubleshooting Guides
    Step-by-step solutions for common embroidery machine errors and operational issues.

  • Maintenance Instructions
    Cleaning, lubrication, adjustment, and preventive maintenance procedures.

  • Repair Knowledge
    Technical explanations of machine components, mechanical systems, and repair methods.

item.title: Why Incorrect Needle Direction Causes Thread Breaks
item.description:
If your embroidery thread keeps breaking and the broken area looks fuzzy, frayed, or damaged, the problem may not be thread tension. In many cases, the cause is an incorrectly installed needle or incorrect needle direction.

Symptoms

You may notice one or more of the following:

  • The upper thread breaks repeatedly during embroidery.
  • The thread break point looks fuzzy or worn out.
  • The thread appears to be cut or scraped instead of cleanly broken.
  • The same needle position keeps causing thread breaks.
  • Adjusting thread tension does not solve the problem.
